a.name_zh: 一级亲属乳腺癌家族史

reference.quote: Gastric cancer (11.97%) was the most common site recorded for family members, followed by colorectal and lung (5.75%), prostate (4.37%), breast (3.43%) and liver (3.05%) cancer.
reference.source: 日本 NC-CCAPH 七个队列合并的一级亲属该部位癌症家族史比例（3.43，男女合计%）；缺中国人群同口径数据，暂用日本人群，未分性别年龄，所有性别年龄段共用一行

overlap.rationale_zh: 本项只计疾病结局。荟萃分析合并 76 项研究（71 项病例对照、5 项队列）的 OR，各研究多只按年龄匹配或校正，未校正多基因评分、BRCA1/2 致病变异、BMI 与饮酒。家族史部分由这些已计入项解释（遗传部分对应评分与致病变异，共享生活方式部分对应 BMI、饮酒），按规则（仅校正年龄）系数上限 0.3，取 0.3。

population.cohort: studies of Asian women (systematic review and meta-analysis, mostly case-control)
population.events_source_zh: 未给合并病例数；全文写明 76 项研究共纳入 5,184,024 名女性，属大型合并分析

measurement.source: 自述一级亲属（父母、兄弟姐妹、子女）患病史，存在回忆误差

interventions.note_zh: 家族史不可改变；有乳腺癌家族史者可考虑遗传咨询，并按指南提前做乳腺影像筛查。

test.label_zh: 询问父母、兄弟姐妹、子女是否患过乳腺癌

evidence.quote: The pooled OR for women who have a first-degree relative with breast cancer was 2.46 (95% confidence interval [CI]: 2.03, 2.97).

b.name_zh: 一级亲属乳腺癌家族史

reference.quote: 7496 (12.9%) women with breast cancer and 7438 (7.3%) controls reported that one or more first-degree relatives had a history of breast cancer
reference.estimated_reason_zh: 7.3% 为 52 项（以欧美为主）病例对照研究中对照组自报一级亲属乳腺癌史比例，非中国人群；未找到中国人群分年龄数据

breast_ca.per_unit: 有（1 名）vs 无一级亲属乳腺癌史

evidence.quote: Risk ratios for breast cancer increased with increasing numbers of affected first-degree relatives: compared with women who had no affected relative, the ratios were 1.80 (99% CI 1.69-1.91), 2.93 (2.36-3.64), and 3.90 (2.03-7.49), respectively, for one, two, and three or more affected first-degree relatives

b.estimand_zh: 52 项流行病学研究个体数据合并（58,209 例乳腺癌）：一名一级亲属有乳腺癌史 vs 无的乳腺癌风险比（条件 logistic，置信区间为 99% CI，更保守；病例对照为主，欧美为主）

overlap.rationale_zh: 家族史与其他已计入项无同病种重叠

evidence.quote: Risk ratios for breast cancer increased with increasing numbers of affected first-degree relatives: compared with women who had no affected relative, the ratios were 1.80 (99% CI 1.69-1.91), 2.93 (2.36-3.64), and 3.90 (2.03-7.49), respectively, for one, two, and three or more affected first-degree relatives

alternatives_considered.reason: 摘要无病例数，且排序低于个体数据合并分析

why: indicator：每 1 单位 2.46 与 1.8，不在彼此的 95% 置信区间内
两次独立建项不一致：indicator：每 1 单位 2.46 与 1.8，不在彼此的 95% 置信区间内
